justification: Both surfaces include small standing human figures rendered in relief, but beyond this generic overlap the content diverges sharply: A centers on a symbolic emblem flanked by tiny worshipper-like figures above a long inscribed text field, while B depicts a horizontal processional frieze of walking figures followed by camels and a plant motif, with no text or emblem. The arrangement (vertical stele with figures-over-text vs. a continuous horizontal narrative procession) and the specific motifs (camels, foliage vs. inscription, central symbol) show no meaningful correspondence.
